title: Week 3 of remaking my childhood dragon TD game
author: 328amdev
selftext:
Here's week 3 of making Broodguard, my 3D take on Lair Defense Shrine and Dungeon. Everything in this clip was recorded on the new Sand Dunes stage.

# What's new this week.

A Genealogy Tree for unlocking new dragon forms, three mutations for elder dragons (Snow Banshee, Storm Wraith and Catastrophe) and three new enemies (War Boar, Brood Toad and Plague Doctor). The video shows what each one does.

# Workflow.

The background music in this clip was made with Gemini's Create music tool. Describing the mood didn't do much, so I wrote the prompt as bar-numbered sections with a set tempo and named which instruments play in each section. It got the tempo and the climax right, but it ignores the key and always fades out at the end, so I cut the loop on bar boundaries myself.

# What's next.

Sound effects, with a new workflow. For each enemy I send Gemini its reference images and its set of animations (walk, run and carry), and have it generate short videos with the sound already on them. Because the audio is generated for the movement on screen, the footsteps, grunts and impacts line up with the motion, which I couldn't get out of tools like ElevenLabs. Those videos become the first pass, and I'll iterate on the SFX from there.

>`Still aiming to have a working demo soon!`  
`Just been a bit busier than usual at work.`
